o.text: From Proto-Turkic *tāpan (“foot, sole”). Cognate with Turkish taban (“sole of a foot”), Kazakh табан (taban, “foot, sole”), Bashkir табан (taban, “heel”), Kyrgyz таман (taman, “foot, sole”), Chuvash тупан (tup̬an), etc.
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *bȫg. Cognate with Ottoman Turkish بوی (böy), بو (bö), Turkish böğ, bö, Bashkir бөйө (büyü), Kyrgyz бөйү (böyü), бөө (böö).
From Arabic رَغْمًا (raḡman), adverbial accusative of رَغْم (raḡm).
